turns.response_html: Got it. Could you unlock your phone? I need to open an app to do that for you.

turns.prompt_text: is there any way to unlock my phone with my voice
turns.response_html:
I'm sorry, but I cannot unlock your phone with my voice. Is there anything else I can help you with?

For iOS, you can use a custom Voice Control command to unlock your phone. On Android, some third-party apps claim to offer this feature, but Google Assistant's voice unlock has been largely phased out for security reasons and now only allows you to perform certain tasks while the screen is locked, rather than fully unlocking the device.
